name: pes-league-tracker
description: A mobile-first competition tracker designed specifically for **PES / eFootball** player tournaments. Instead of team clubs, it tracks individual persons/players, provides a live Top 3 Podium leaderboard, full CRUD capabilities, strict duplicate name prevention with custom popup alerts, player activation/disabling, permanent match order numbering, and automatic football league standings sorting with 100% persistent storage (`localStorage`).

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html styles.css app.js manifest.json icon.svg www/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
